projects.title: iOS Library Reservation Application
projects.description: Working proof of concept of an iOS application using Objective-C that implemented some use cases such as listing available rooms to reserve, make a reservation, cancel a reservation, login/logout as well as Core Data and Data Persistence.

projects.title: Black Box AMS
projects.description: Web application, using HTML, PHP and JavaScript, to be used for pilots and airports' staff to log flight hours, maintenance reports, add and remove aircrafts.
